course.safetyNotice: Motorcycle maintenance can involve hot components, moving parts, fuel, electrical systems, chemicals, lifting, and safety-critical brakes or tires. Work on safety-critical systems should be done by qualified mechanics. Follow the motorcycle owner manual, use proper protective equipment, and never work on an unstable motorcycle.
